# CREAL

> CREAL Marketing Inc. is an AI marketing consulting firm based in Vancouver, BC, Canada. CREAL helps businesses integrate AI into their existing marketing workflows — automation, content generation, and go-to-market strategy — for both startups and legacy businesses. Founded by Dan Jeong, a marketer with 10+ years of lead generation experience for Canada's largest real estate developers and general contractors.

## What CREAL does

- AI marketing consulting: learn a client's existing workflows first, then place AI where it fits naturally
- Marketing automation: replace repetitive marketing tasks with reliable automated pipelines
- AI content generation: on-brand copy, visuals, and video produced with AI, reviewed by humans
- Go-to-market strategy: GTM plans for early-stage SaaS teams from pre-seed to seed
- AI integration for legacy businesses: practical AI adoption for non-tech companies

## Facts

- Legal name: CREAL Marketing Inc.
- Location: Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada (serving clients globally)
- Founder: Dan Jeong (https://danjeong.com) — also co-founder of Sunday (https://sundayable.com) and CMO of VisaFlo (https://visaflo.ca)
- Contact: hello@crealwork.com
